is in an arrangement with Erasca
to evaluate navlimetostat in combination with the latter's ERAS-0015 for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, the most common form of pancreatic cancer.
Erasca will supply ERAS-0015, a potentially best-in-class pan-RAS molecular glue. Navlimetostat is considered a PRMT5 inhibitor. Bristol will run the trial.
ERAS-0015 is also currently in the AURORAS-1 phase 1 trial in patients with RAS-mutant solid tumors.

Navlimetostat (BMS-986504) is in a phase 2 trial evaluating it as monotherapy and in combination with Bristol's experimental antibody-drug conjugate izalontamab brengitecan for non-small cell lung cancer.

title: Bristol to evaluate navlimetostat in combination with Erasca asset
